text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty -> INCIDENT: Orchard Health (enterprise-vpc) - tenant mTLS failures detected across dedicated pool. High error rate (503/handshake) from ingress since 07:02 UTC. Paging oncall.

alex.chen: acked, I'm on it. Can someone pull the pool metrics and client cert rejection logs? @infra-eng @oncall-sre

oncall-sre: grabbing logs now. Initial look: spike in TLS alert 40 (handshake_failure) correlating with client cert validation failures. Many shows 'depth 0, verify error: unable to get local issuer certificate'

mateo: +1 that sounds like a missing intermediate on the client chain. Which rotation ran recently for Orchard? @cs-liaison can you confirm customer actions?

cs-liaison: Orchard's infra team confirmed they triggered their cert rotation ~06:50 UTC. They said they pushed a new leaf cert but used their existing intermediate. They also said they finished and saw success on their side.

priya.kumar: interesting — server side (our ingress) validates the full chain for client mTLS. If customer's bundle didn't include intermediate, our verifier will fail. Can we confirm whether our rotation or policy changed to stricter chain validation in last deploy? @infra-eng

infra-eng: no deploys to validation logic in the last 72h. We do have a config change for stricter CA pinning that rolled 3 days ago but it was scoped. Checking cluster config for Orchard pool now.

alex.chen: capture of nginx-side logs from 07:00-07:10 attached (pasted):
```
[07:03:12] TLS handshake failed: alert 40: unable to get local issuer certificate (subject=/CN=client-orchard)... verify return -1
[07:03:13] TLS handshake failed: alert 40: certificate verify failed: self signed certificate in chain
```

julia.ng: also seeing an uptick in requests hitting fallback route (hosted-routes) for some tenants; routing policy attempted fallback but some tokens expired causing 401s downstream. Customer impact: partial traffic degradation for Orchard-managed endpoints and increased latency for routed requests.

oncall-sre: immediate mitigation options:
1) Ask Orchard to reissue bundle with full chain (intermediate + leaf) — best fix but depends on customer.
2) Temporarily relax chain validation for this tenant in our ingress (enable accept_partial_chain=true) — risky but buys time.
3) Route Orchard traffic to hosted inference (no mTLS to their client) while they fix cert chain — requires token rerouting and short TTLs.

alex.chen: I think we should try 2) short window while 3) is prepared. Need engineering approval and revert plan. If we touch validation flags, we'll scope to tenant ID and add automatic revert after 1 hour.

mateo: +1. I can implement a tenant-scoped relax flag on the ingress LB in ~10-15m and add a guard that reverts after 30m. Will push as a controlled runtime config, no code change.

priya.kumar: make sure we also add a request-id header to all proxied requests so downstream logs can correlate if things degrade. Also add a devhook to notify when the revert timer fires.

infra-eng: prepping the change. Command I'll run (shared for audit):
```
# enable partial chain acceptance for tenant orchard-id-482
redwoodctl config set ingress.pool.orchard-id-482.accept_partial_chain=true --expires 30m --author "mateo"
```

oncall-sre: applying now. Monitoring handshake failures and 5xx.

oncall-sre: update: after toggle at 07:20 UTC, client handshake errors dropped 96%. Traffic restored to baseline for Orchard. No change in error budget for other tenants.

cs-liaison: notified Orchard support: they responded they will reissue with full chain within next 45m. They appreciate the temporary workaround. CS drafting status email to customer and exec.

alex.chen: good. Now prepare plan B: if customer cannot reissue, we need to switch to hosted routing for all their external clients. @julia.ng can you estimate token migration steps and downtime?

julia.ng: hosted route swap will take ~20m to activate once routing config is ready. Need to ensure secrets/credentials are valid and we rotate consumer tokens to avoid reuse. Some sessions will drop. Recommend scheduled switch window.

priya.kumar: capture for postmortem: root cause: customer-issued incomplete cert bundle + strict mTLS validation. Contributing factor: no pre-rotation chain-check by their ops. Action items now:
- (CS) confirm Orchard will provide full PEM bundle (leaf+intermediate+root if needed)
- (Eng) add tenant-level preflight validation for cert bundles in rotation workflow
- (Infra) add automated revert and alert on tenant relax flags
- (SRE) update runbook to include fast-hosted-fallback steps

mateo: I'm scheduling a short canary revert at 07:50 UTC to validate that once Orchard pushes full chain, we can revert safely. I'll annotate the config change with audit id 07-orchard-relax.

oncall-sre: monitoring graph: handshake failures near zero post-toggle, request latency normalized. No new regressions. Keeping page open until we revert.

cs-liaison: Orchard confirms they've generated a new bundle and will push at 07:40 UTC. They attached their PEM; quick check looks correct (contains intermediate and leaf).

infra-eng: applying verification step on the bundle now against our chain store: verification ok. Proceeding to request revert of accept_partial_chain flag.

mateo: reverting now (audit id 07-orchard-relax) with auto-checkpost:
```
redwoodctl config set ingress.pool.orchard-id-482.accept_partial_chain=false --author "mateo" && redwoodctl check ingress.pool.orchard-id-482 --test-mtls
```

oncall-sre: revert applied at 07:52 UTC. Post-revert check shows successful handshakes and no spike in 5xx. Orchard traffic stable.

cs-liaison: informed Orchard and shared timeline + short RCA. They are satisfied and will add intermediate to their rotation docs.

julia.ng: closing loop: created a follow-up ticket TODOs:
- add client cert bundle preflight to rotation UI (ENG-8763)
- add tenant-scoped runtime flag audit + revert automation (SRE-4321)
- update runbook and customer guidance (CS-221)

alex.chen: excellent work team. I'll create the incident report and set sev=2 for tracking. Anyone else? If not, wrapping the page in 30m unless regressions.

incident-bot: Incident resolved -> Status: mitigated. Duration: 00:50. Handled by oncall-sre, mateo, infra-eng, priya.kumar, alex.chen, cs-liaison, julia.ng. Postmortem required.

mateo: thanks everyone. Adding notes and commands to the incident archive.

oncall-sre: thanks — paging closed :white_check_mark:
